questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content:
Consider the reaction sequence given below:
Which of the following statements is true?

options.content:
Changing the concentration of base will
have no effect on reaction (1)

Changing the concentration of base will
have no effect on reaction (2)

Changing the base from OH<sup>-</sup> to <sup>-</sup>OR will
have no effect on reaction (2)

Doubling the concentration of base will
double the rate of both the reactions

questions.explanation:
For reaction 1,
rate = K [t-BuBr] ....(1)

for reaction 2,
rate = K[t-BuBr][OH–] ...(2)

Reaction 1 is independent of concentration of OH– where as reaction 2 is dependent on concentration of OH–

Hence changing the concentration of base will have no effect on reaction 1.
